scope: Request one authentic CAP Alert plus at least one linked Update or Cancel for a read-only message-series/card-history check.

request_guidance.accept: application/cap+xml for CAP v1.2 product; default alert indexes use JSON-LD
request_guidance.user_agent: NWS API docs require an identifying User-Agent for application requests
request_guidance.rate_limit_guidance: NWS docs recommend no more frequent than one request every 30 seconds; no polling loop requested
request_guidance.raw_body_sha256: Compute only from exact source bytes actually returned; do not hash rendered/reconstructed text

required_message_series: one Update or Cancel whose references explicitly name its predecessor
all messages named in references, when retrievable; at least one prior message is mandatory
required_capture_metadata: available response headers (Date, ETag, Last-Modified, Content-Type)
local observation/receipt time if actually exposed
raw body SHA-256 only when raw bytes are available

claim_limits.source_declared_message_relation: May be established by an Update/Cancel reference to a named earlier CAP message, subject to preserving both records.
claim_limits.source_independence: UNKNOWN without attributable independent acquisition paths and appropriate receipts/logs; multiple versions/references are not independent sources.
claim_limits.delivery_latency: UNKNOWN without receiver-side capture time; CAP sent is not received.
claim_limits.industrial_safety_effect: Not established by weather CAP data.

observed_access_failures.result: Browser connector said URL was not accessible via this tool.
Browser connector rejected application/vnd.oai.openapi+json as unsupported content type.
Browser connector returned HTTP 502 Bad Gateway.
